items.title: Welcome to the AGI era of AI governance
items.summary: The executive branch of the United States forcing Anthropic to turn off access — both internally and externally — to their latest Claude 5 Mythos/Fable models is the starting gun of a new era in AI governance. This is the era defining AI agents that effectively complement human workers, unlocking new ways of working and new domains of applying existing tools.
